payload.summary: Consolidated two independent reviews and resolved all high/medium plan findings. The revision now freezes complete correlation, pagination, process-health, persistence, security, runtime, retention, backup, coexistence, validation, and package-scope contracts while preserving a cutover-ready-only boundary.
completed_work: Aligned explicit-null OperationContext and completed generated review stubs.
Added cursor-paginated attempt history and aggregate process health contracts.
Completed SQL boundaries for queue context, attempts, health, audit, terminal events, and inactive ownership.
Defined measurable telemetry, storage, backup, and soak thresholds.
Reconciled cutover-ready scope and shared-authority fencing.
Corrected task dependencies, real file scopes, evidence commands, and integration ownership.

decisions.title: Cutover-ready scope
decisions.rationale: Production data migration, public traffic switching, and mutation-owner activation remain in a separately approved change.

decisions.title: One shared fence authority
decisions.rationale: Any future coexistence handoff must use one authoritative PostgreSQL fingerprint and epoch; independent local epochs are rejected.

decisions.title: Portable GX-10 baseline
decisions.rationale: Compose V2 under systemd, Caddy, OpenBao, and a dedicated managed filesystem match repository patterns and are testable.

decisions.title: Bounded dual-layer evidence
decisions.rationale: PostgreSQL stores one bounded attempt summary and process health while Langfuse retains detailed stage history.
